sasha: Draft (heroes  subhead  CTA)
- Hosted: "Try Redwood Hosted"  "Prototype quickly, scale without friction."  "Start free"
- Dedicated: "Reserved capacity"  "Throughput and SLOs for production."  "Reserve capacity"
- Private: "Private deployments"  "VPC, KMS, and on-prem options for regulated workloads."  "Request demo"

tom: Benchmark teaser (social-safe): "Join our live session for an independent demo and a benchmark walkthrough comparing Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments."

erin: Webinar format: 30m demo, 15m benchmark walkthrough, 15m live Q&A. Reg page must ask "deployment interest" so we route correctly.

tom: HubSpot routing pseudo (ops to convert):
```
# form field: deployment_interest -> hosted | dedicated | private
if deployment_interest == "hosted":
  set lifecycle_stage = "MQL"; owner = "marketing"; add_hidden(utm_campaign=launch_webinar)

  assign.owner = "AE_pool"; tag = "dedicated_inquiry"; notify = "ae-team@redwood.com"
if deployment_interest == "private":
  assign.owner = "Enterprise_SDR"; priority = "high"; notify = "sales-enterprise@redwood.com"
```
